content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Winston-Salem

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Review PMI's education and professional experience requirements for the PMP credential. You'll need either a four-year degree with specific project-management experience, or a high-school diploma with additional years in the field. Verify your background meets PMI standards before proceeding.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP preparation course. Our instructors deliver the PMI-mandated contact hours on a schedule that fits working professionals. You'll learn the PMBOK® Guide framework, exam domains, and real-world application in an interactive classroom setting.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Create your PMI account and submit your PMP application, including documentation of your education and project-management experience. Pay the required exam fee through PMI's portal. Our team can guide you through the submission process to ensure accuracy and avoid delays.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice questions, study guides, and instructor support. Schedule your exam at a testing center convenient to you. On exam day, you'll answer questions designed to assess your knowledge of project-management principles and the PMBOK® Guide.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, commit to a three-year renewal cycle. Earn professional development units (PDUs) through training, conference attendance, volunteer work, or mentoring. Granite PM Academy offers continuing-education courses to help you meet renewal requirements and stay current in the field.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
